📖 How to use

  1. Pick a currency pair, lot size and trade direction (long/short).
  2. Enter your entry and exit prices.
  3. Read pip count, pip value and profit/loss.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a pip?

A pip is 0.0001 for most pairs and 0.01 for JPY pairs. Pips moved = |exit − entry| ÷ pip size.

How is pip value in USD found?

For pairs quoted in USD (EURUSD…), one pip per standard lot = $10. For USD/JPY style pairs it is converted: pip size × 100,000 × lots ÷ exit price.

How do long and short differ?

Long profits when the exit is above entry; short profits when it is below. The sign of (exit − entry) × direction gives the P/L sign.
